personas.label: کاربر عادی شرکت
personas.authority_shape: Active tenant membership; ordinary read permissions; no privileged admin assumptions.

personas.label: کاربر عملیاتی پروژه / مهندس کارگاه
personas.authority_shape: Project-scoped membership with create/view permissions for selected operational surfaces.
context_requirements: at least two sites across different projects

personas.label: کارشناس تدارکات
personas.authority_shape: Procurement view/create/evaluate permissions within bounded project scope.

personas.label: کارشناس تجهیزات و ناوگان
personas.authority_shape: Equipment/fleet permissions within known tenant/project scope; no inventory-custody authority inferred.

personas.label: حسابدار
personas.authority_shape: Accounting view/create permissions for non-production test organization.

personas.label: کارشناس خزانه‌داری
personas.authority_shape: Treasury movement and operation permissions only as required by scenario.

personas.label: کارشناس صورتحساب، مطالبات و پرداخت‌های پیمان
personas.authority_shape: Billing/AP-AR/subledger permissions only as actually granted; no Contract Admin or Treasury authority inferred.

personas.label: کارشناس عملیات منابع انسانی و پرونده پرسنلی
personas.authority_shape: Workforce/employee administration permissions; no Payroll, Timekeeping or Tenant Admin authority inferred.

personas.label: کارمند در خودخدمتی
personas.authority_shape: Self-service own-data access only.

personas.label: کارشناس حضور و غیاب و کارکرد
personas.authority_shape: Timekeeping permissions within tenant/employee scope; no Payroll calculation authority inferred.

personas.label: کارشناس HSE و ایمنی
personas.authority_shape: Safety/HSE permissions in known tenant/project scope; no Quality/QC authority inferred.

personas.label: متولی دانش
personas.authority_shape: Knowledge curate/review permissions; platform review tested only with actual platform authority.

personas.label: مدیر گردش‌کار
personas.authority_shape: Actual workflow administration permission; no generic tenant-admin inference.

personas.label: کاربر آزمون دسترس‌پذیری
personas.authority_shape: Use actual least-privileged identities appropriate for each visited surface.
context_requirements: representative records for high-risk detail/list/form pages

personas.label: مالک شرکت / Tenant Owner
personas.authority_shape: Actual Tenant Owner authority only; never substitute Platform Admin. Organization-wide visibility may exist, but platform or other-tenant authority must not.
context_requirements: representative attention/exception/approval items where naturally available
at least one lower-privilege comparison identity

personas.label: ادمین شرکت / Tenant Admin
personas.authority_shape: Actual Tenant Admin/local-admin authority under BONIRA governance; no implicit Owner or Platform Admin authority.
context_requirements: existing tenant roles and scope grants

personas.label: مدیر پروژه / Project Manager
personas.authority_shape: Actual project-manager-equivalent effective permissions and project scope; do not infer broad financial/HR authority from title.
context_requirements: project operational records across multiple modules
at least one out-of-scope project for boundary comparison

personas.label: ادمین پلتفرم / Platform Admin
personas.authority_shape: Actual Platform Admin authority. This persona is not a Tenant Owner or Tenant Admin substitute and must not be used for ordinary tenant journeys.

personas.label: مسئول کنترل اسناد / Document Controller
personas.authority_shape: Document-management permissions within known tenant/project scope; no Knowledge-curator or Platform authority inferred.
context_requirements: at least one document with multiple versions

personas.label: کارشناس حقوق و دستمزد
personas.authority_shape: Payroll calculation/review permissions only; no Timekeeping source-edit authority or Treasury final-payment authority inferred.

personas.label: کارشناس احکام و سوابق استخدامی
personas.authority_shape: Existing employment-record management and employee-view permissions; do not infer Payroll or Tenant Admin authority.
context_requirements: employee with active work relationship and revision
source document with safe available version
current and historical employment records where available
ESS employee able to view own employment history

personas.label: انباردار / کارشناس کنترل موجودی
personas.authority_shape: Inventory/material permissions for assigned warehouses/projects; no Equipment or Accounting authority inferred.

personas.label: کارشناس قراردادها و امور تجاری
personas.authority_shape: Contracts/commercial permissions within tenant/project scope; no Procurement Buyer or Billing settlement authority inferred.

personas.label: کارشناس کنترل پروژه / دفتر فنی
personas.authority_shape: Project-controls/estimate permissions for explicitly scoped projects; no Project Owner or Accounting authority inferred.

personas.label: کارشناس کیفیت / QA-QC
personas.authority_shape: Quality/QA-QC permissions within known project/site scope; no HSE authority inferred.

personas.label: تأمین‌کننده / شریک بیرونی در پرتال
personas.authority_shape: External/portal grant only for the intended invitation/receipt/opportunity; no ordinary tenant membership assumed.
context_requirements: active RFQ invitation or portal grant
